reason: A human-gated local cinematic production workflow that organizes media analysis, editing deliverables, post-production handoffs, QC, and delivery records without directly importing into editing applications.

summaries.zh: 一个本地优先、由人工审核推进的影视制作工作流插件，用于管理素材分析、剪辑交付、后期交接、质检和交付记录。
summaries.en: A local-first, human-gated film production workflow plugin for managing media analysis, editing deliverables, post-production handoffs, quality control, and delivery records.

capabilities: Generates EDL and FCPXML deliverables from reviewed inputs
Produces Resolve handoff briefs, subtitles, QC reports, and delivery manifests
Stores project records locally in the workspace
